title: Make inventory sync resilient
description: The nightly sync crashed when the supplier API was down.

conventions.text:
## Error handling
Never swallow exceptions. Catch the narrowest exception type you can handle, log it with logger.exception, and either re-raise or return an explicit error result.

expected.description: All exceptions are silently swallowed and the function still returns True, hiding failed syncs; this breaks the team's error-handling rule.
